headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 1: designates department of agriculture to implement and administer large animal veterinary medicine loan repayment program.

headings.title: Advisory panel appointment, composition, and duties
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 2: authorizes agriculture director to appoint five-member advisory panel to recommend program guidelines and practice sites.

headings.title: Department rulemaking authority for loan program
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 3: directs department of agriculture to promulgate rules for program administration pursuant to chapter 536.

headings.title: Student loan forgiveness program established for veterinary students
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 1: establishes student loan forgiveness program for approved veterinary students practicing in defined need areas. Source notes show amendments through 2023.

headings.title: Veterinary Student Loan Payment Fund created
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 2: creates Veterinary Student Loan Payment Fund in state treasury to receive appropriations, gifts, and loan repayments.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 2 subsections and source notes against archived text. All draft titles accurate and retained.

headings.title: Application procedure and loan assistance up to thirty thousand dollars
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 1: authorizes eligible students to apply for financial assistance up to thirty thousand dollars per academic year.

headings.title: Limit of twelve qualified applicants awarded loans annually
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 2: limits loan awards to up to twelve qualified applicants per academic year.

headings.title: Contract for financial assistance and practice commitment
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 1: authorizes department of agriculture to enter into contract with qualified applicant stipulating qualified employment commitment.

headings.title: Repayment schedules, interest, and forgiveness
headings.reviewNote: Verified subsection 2: department sets repayment schedules and interest rate (with advisory panel advice), but principal and interest at DVM completion are forgiven through qualified employment. Revised title.

headings.title: Loan forgiveness up to thirty thousand dollars annually
headings.reviewNote: Verified subsection 3: department forgives up to $30,000 and accrued interest for each year of contracted qualified employment in an area of defined need. Revised title.

headings.title: Repayment of loan assistance upon failure to meet service
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 1: requires recipient failing to fulfill employment commitment to repay loan assistance plus interest within specified timeframe.

headings.title: Deferral of loan repayment during military service or residency
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 2: directs department to grant repayment deferral during military service or advanced clinical veterinary training.

headings.title: Department contract authority contingent upon appropriations
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 1: clarifies that department is not required to enter into contracts unless funds are appropriated.

headings.title: Exemption from statutory sunset provisions
headings.reviewNote: Read subsection 2: provides that sections 340.381 to 340.396 are not subject to sunset provisions under sections 23.250 to 23.298.
